scope: Minnesota Project expansion into nursing/public administration and adjacent Korean implementation actors

actors.name: 이승만
actions: A University of Minnesota nursing-adviser final report states that the SNU College of Medicine Department of Nursing was officially established through President Rhee's approval on 1959-01-13.
actors.attribution_limits: This is a contemporaneous project report describing presidential approval. It does not by itself establish who drafted the underlying decree/order, the full cabinet routing, or that Rhee personally designed the nursing reform.
open_leads: recover Ministry of Education routing and SNU proposal
determine whether approval was a routine statutory presidential act or followed substantive presidential intervention

actors.name: 이귀향

roles.role: Principal, SNU School of Nursing / nursing educator; six-month Minnesota participant
roles.evidence: University of Minnesota Archives institutional overview

roles.role: Director, Department of Nursing, SNU College of Medicine
roles.evidence: University of Minnesota nursing-adviser final report

actions: participated in Minnesota nursing training and later was elected by the SNU medical faculty to direct the new four-year nursing department
actors.attribution_limits: Training participation and later election are verified; do not infer sole authorship of the 1959 departmental reform.
open_leads: recover her 1975 SNU nursing-history account for participant-side testimony

actors.name: 김동익

roles.role: Director, SNU College of Medicine Hospital
roles.evidence: Seoul National University Hospital official history

actions: official SNU Hospital history places Kim as hospital director during the nursing-department establishment period; Minnesota archival material also identifies a hospital administrator Dong Ik Kim in project imagery
actors.attribution_limits: The nursing final-report excerpt says the Dean of Medicine strongly supported reserving a new faculty position, but this pass does not yet identify that dean as Kim Dong-ik. Hospital-director and dean offices must not be conflated.
open_leads: identify 1959 College of Medicine dean from official SNU roster

actors.name: 김원규

roles.evidence: secondary school chronology located in this pass; official personnel record still needed

actions: UMedia labels an unidentified Mr. Kim as principal of Seoul High School in the 1954-12-08 Minnesota photograph; a school chronology places Kim Won-gyu in that office at the date
actors.attribution_limits: Keep the merge provisional until an official Seoul High School/Ministry roster or accession note confirms the full name.
open_leads: recover official 1954 Seoul High School principal roster

actors.name: 홍춘기

roles.role: Professor, SNU College of Engineering, mining engineering participant
roles.evidence: Fifth semiannual report notes Smithsonian mineral collection requested by Professor Hong, Choon Ki while in Washington in 1956

actions: requested a Smithsonian collection of about 60 rock/mineral/ore specimens for SNU Mining Engineering; the fifth semiannual report records arrival in Korea on 1957-06-22
actors.attribution_limits: Identity/bio beyond project role remains open; do not promote to politician registry without later public-office or political relevance.
open_leads: identify Korean/hanja spelling from SNU engineering records
trace later public-sector mining role if any

actors.name: 주영한

roles.role: Korean Consul General in San Francisco

actions: addressed Korean faculty members and other Korean students at a University of Minnesota social event
actors.attribution_limits: Romanization-to-Hangul bridge is provisional until Korean diplomatic roster is recovered.
open_leads: identify diplomatic role in educational exchange facilitation

actors.name: 이종수

roles.role: SNU academic dean/academic affairs administrator in mid-1950s
roles.evidence: University of Minnesota archival caption plus biographical chronology

actions: University of Minnesota archival overview identifies Chong Soo Lee as Academic Dean in a project-era leadership photograph with Schneider
actors.attribution_limits: Exact date and office term during the photographed event require SNU official personnel records.

actors.name: 권중휘

roles.role: Dean of Students, Seoul National University

actions: appears in Minnesota archival project imagery receiving greetings from chief adviser Arthur Schneider with Lee Jong-su and Yun Il-sun
actors.attribution_limits: Presence verifies administrative participation, not a specific policy decision.
open_leads: trace student-affairs role in fellow selection and project administration

actors.name: 1959 서울대 의과대학장 (미확인)

roles.evidence: Minnesota nursing-adviser final report refers to the dean's strong support for reserving a new faculty position for nursing

actions: supported allocation of one Ministry of Education faculty position to the new nursing department
actors.attribution_limits: Do not guess the personal identity from hospital-director rosters.
open_leads: recover official 1959 SNU College of Medicine dean roster

roles.role: Ministry of Education official(s) responsible for new SNU faculty-position allocation
